text: “Shall I say a word to Madame?” “Certainly,” said my father. He called Madame to him, and said: “I find my young friend here far from well. It won’t be of any great consequence, I hope; but it will be necessary that some steps be taken, which I will explain by-and-by; but in the meantime, Madame, you will be so good as not to let Miss Laura be alone for one moment. That is the only direction I need give for the present. It is indispensable.” “We may rely upon your kindness, Madame, I know,” added my father.
